technical.summary: LULU shows oversold conditions with early stochrsi recovery signal, but lacks bullish confirmation across momentum, trend, and volume indicators in a downtrend environment.

fundamental.summary: LULU shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk with 22 days to announcement.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is absent and stale (6+ months old); no news data available to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (436.48), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent CPI event create severe macro headwinds; earnings in 22 days adds moderate binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI conditions (9 and 14) with stochrsi cross-up and contrarian fear-zone sentiment (14/100) create a classic reversal setup for contrarian traders willing to catch a falling knife.
debate.key_bear_argument: Complete absence of bullish confirmation across momentum, trend, volume, and macro indicators—combined with crisis-level VIX, imminent earnings binary risk, unfavorable macro environment, and price deeply below all major moving averages—makes this a high-probability bear trap rather than a genuine reversal.

decision.entry_rationale: Oversold RSI conditions and extreme fear sentiment present a contrarian setup, but lack of bullish confirmation across all momentum, trend, and volume indicators combined with crisis-level macro headwinds make this a high-probability bear trap rather than a genuine reversal opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis-level VIX (436.48), imminent earnings binary event (22 days), and price deeply below all major moving averages create severe downside risk if oversold bounce fails to hold.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, and risk agents all signal weakness; only sentiment offers contrarian perspective but lacks confirmation
